def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=get_comps(g,bg)
    cand=[c_ for c_ in comps if len(c_)>1 and any(g[p[0]][p[1]]==3 for p in c_)]
    templ=max(cand,key=len) if cand else None
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if templ is None: return out
    anc=[p for p in templ if g[p[0]][p[1]]==3][0]
    rels=[(x-anc[0],y-anc[1]) for x,y in templ if g[x][y]!=3]
    for r,c in [(x,y) for x in range(H) for y in range(W) if g[x][y]==3]:

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=get_comps([row[:] for r in g for row in [r]] if False else g,bg)
    # template = multi-cell comp containing a 3
    templ=max([c for c in comps if len(c)>1 and any(v==3 for v in [g[r][cc] for rr,cc in c])],key=len)
    ts=[(r,c) for r,cc in templ for c in [cc] ]
    # find the 3 cell of the template
    t3=[cell for cell in templ if g[cell[0]][cell[1]]==3]
    assert len(t3)==1, t3
    (tr_,tc_)=t3[0]
    rels={((r-tr_)+(c-tc_), c) : (rr-r_, cc-c_) for r,cc in templ for (r_,c_) in []} 
    # simpler: relative offsets from the template's 3 cell
    rels={(r-tr_, c-tc_) for r,c in templ}
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for c in comps:
        cells3=[(r,c2) for r,cc in c for c2 in [cc]]
        has3=any(g[r][cc]==3 for r,cc in c)
        others=[(r,cc,v) for r,cc in c if v!=3 and v!=bg]
        if has3 and not others:  # isolated single 3
            for dr,dc in rels:
                r,c2=tr_+dr,tc_+dc

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=get_comps(g,bg)
    templ=max([c for c in comps if len(c)>1 and any(v==3 for r,cc,v in [(r,cc,g[r][cc]) for r,cc in c])],key=len)
    tcells=[(r,cc,g[r][cc]) for r,cc in templ]
    tr_,tc_=next((r,cc) for r,cc in templ if g[r][cc]==3)
    Tc=next(v for r,cc,v in tcells if v not in (bg,3))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    anchors=[(r2,cc2,g[r2][cc2]) for c in comps if len(c)==1 for r2,cc2 in c]
    for mr,mc,v in anchors:
        if v==3:
            for r,ccvv,aav in tcells:
                if aav==3: continue
                rr,ccx=r+mr-tr_,ccvv+mc-tc_
                if 0<=rr<H and 0<=ccx<W and g[rr][ccx]==bg:
                    out[rr][ccx]=Tc
        elif v==2:
            rr,ccx=mr-1,mc
            if 0<=rr<H and 0<=ccx<W and g[rr][ccx]==bg:
                out[rr][ccx]=4
    return out
for i in (1,2,3,4):
    gi,go=G['Demo pair %d input'%i],G['Demo pair %d output'%i]
    o=f(gi)
    bad=[(r,c,o[r][c],go[r][c]) for r in range(len(gi)) for c in range(len(gi[0])) if o[r][c]!=go[r][c]]
    print(i,'match' if not bad else (len(bad),bad[:6]))
out=f(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(out))

def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0]); bg=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=get_comps(gi,bg)
    g=[row[:] for row in gi]
    # templates: multi-comp objects; key: the rarest color inside them
    tpl={}
    for c in comps:
        if len(c)>1:
            cnt=Counter(gi[p[0]][p[1]] for p in c)
            rare=min(cnt,key=lambda k:(cnt[k],k))
            # anchor cell = cell with rare color
            anc=[p for p in c if gi[p[0]][p[1]]==rare][0]
            major=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
            tc=[([p[0]-anc[0],p[1]-anc[1]],v) for p,v in zip(c,[gi[p[0]][p[1]] for p in c])]
            tpl[rare]=(major,[(x,y,v) for x,y,v in tc])
    marks=[next(iter(c)) for c in comps if len(c)==1]
    for m in marks:
        v=gi[m[0]][m[1]]
        if v in tpl:
            maj,cells=tpl[v]
            dr,dc=m[0]-tuple(cells[0][0],cells[0][1])[0],m[1]-cells[0][1]  # buggy below; redo
    return None
# redo cleanly

            rare=min(cnt,key=lambda k:(cnt[k],k))
            anc=[p for p in c if gi[p[0]][p[1]]==rare][0]

            cells=[(p[0]-anc[0],p[1]-anc[1],gi[p[0]][p[1]]) for p in c]
